text.p: Fil-Estate Land Inc said on Wednesday its net income in the first six months ended March was at 1,236 million pesos compared with 908 million a year-ago.
The real estate development firm's fiscal year ends in September.
Total revenues for the six-month period rose to 4.178 billion pesos, up from the year-ago 3.6 billion, the company said in a statement.

It said about 80 percent of total revenues were derived from the sale of integrated residential and golf community development projects. About 10 percent came from the sale of residential condomunium units, it said.
Fil-Estate said it was confident its 1996/97 income forecast of 2.448 billion pesos would be attained.
